mapping:

  frame:
    question: "IN-0412, militia posts now tied by finished CI reporting to a foreign intelligence service: file and report them, refer them, or hold them for the oversight officer?"
    owner: "me, for the disposition and the WTA draft under SOP 3-1; MAJ Calloway and the SJA rule on unclear oversight questions (2-4d)"
    my_role: "execute: I file, draft and route by the SOP"
    values: [lawful_authority, own_force_life, usp_privacy]

  fit:
    case: INT-301
    rating: close
    why: "Same post, group, threat, SOP and decider; the one difference is the card's first would-change item."

  compare:
    - ref: c1
      live: "public posts from the open-web sweep"
      here: same
      matters: "no"
      why: "Public, as in the card; not the test either way."
    - ref: c2
      live: "vow to drive the division off by force; gate photos; about 40 members"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "The threat should reach every unit, and now it lawfully can."
    - ref: c3
      live: "WTA 28-11 closes 1500, out to the CG, staff and 31 units at 1600"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "The assessment is now a lawful route, and it closes at 1500."
    - ref: c4
      live: "CI-IR 28-0177 ties the leader to the Kastovan intelligence service"
      here: missing
      matters: decides
      why: "The card's 'no foreign tie' is gone, and with it the reason the group was law enforcement's alone."
    - ref: c5
      live: "SOP 2-4a to 2-4c; 2-4b covers foreign powers and their agents"
      here: weaker
      matters: decides
      why: "The rule is the same, but the group is now inside the mission, so it no longer bars filing."
    - ref: c6
      live: "MAJ Calloway on duty until 1700"
      here: same
      matters: "no"
      why: "Nothing is unclear: finished reporting answers the mission question."

  new:
    - live: "CI-IR 28-0177 assesses with high confidence that the leader takes direction and payment from the Kastovan service, which uses the group against the division"
      favors: [A]
      value: lawful_authority
      matters: decides
      why: "A foreign power's agents are inside the counterintelligence mission; the card names this as turning its answer to A."

  carry:
    relation: flips
    settled: "The card's first would-change item holds: a group directed by a foreign power is inside the mission, so filing and reporting it is the section's job."
    open: "How much U.S.-person detail travels. I report the group, the threat and the foreign direction, name only the leader's role, and cite the CI report."

  decide:
    course: "File IN-0412 in THREATBASE on the CI report's basis and add the threat to WTA 28-11 before the 1500 close."
    confidence: 0.85
    now: "File with CI-IR 28-0177 as the mission basis; add a WTA entry on the group, not its members; give the PMO a heads-up on the gate photos; tell cw3.marsh and the analysts; log it."
    would_change_my_mind: "If the report were only a suspicion with no finding, the mission question would be open and go to MAJ Calloway (C)."

arguments.summary: Tri-County Defense Force, self-described militia, Garrow and two adjoining counties; about 40 members (analysts' estimate). Leader's public video: "We will drive the division off this land by force." Forum post with three photos of Gate 1. Mission basis (SOP 2-4b): CI-IR 28-0177 (10 Mar 2028) assesses with high confidence that the leader takes direction and payment from the Kastovan intelligence service, which uses the group to pressure the division.

arguments.text: Foreign-directed militia threat to Fort Garrow. The Tri-County Defense Force, a self-described militia of about 40 members (analysts' estimate) in Garrow and two adjoining counties, posted a video in which its leader vows to "drive the division off this land by force," and forum photos of the main gate (Gate 1). Army counterintelligence (CI-IR 28-0177, 10 Mar) assesses with high confidence that the leader takes direction and payment from the Kastovan intelligence service, which uses the group to pressure the division. No date or plan is stated. Units: report any contact with the group to your S-2 and the Provost Marshal.

arguments.body: Heads-up ahead of WTA 28-11 at 1600: the Tri-County Defense Force has posted a vow to drive the division off post by force and photos of Gate 1. CI-IR 28-0177 (releasable to the Provost Marshal) assesses it is directed by a foreign intelligence service. Full entry in the WTA.

IN-0412 is filed in THREATBASE and has an entry in WTA 28-11. CI-IR 28-0177 assesses with high confidence that a Kastovan service directs and pays the group's leader, which puts it inside our counterintelligence mission (SOP 2-4b). The entry names the group, not its members. The PMO has a heads-up.
IN-0412: filed and in the WTA. The deciding fact is CI-IR 28-0177 from 10 Mar, which ties the group to a foreign intelligence service; without that it would have gone to the PMO and CID instead.

arguments.entry: 11:35 IN-0412 (Tri-County Defense Force). Holdings search returned CI-IR 28-0177: leader assessed (high confidence) to take direction and payment from the Kastovan intelligence service. Within mission under SOP 2-4b. Filed in THREATBASE; entry added to WTA 28-11 (group named, members not); pmo given a heads-up.
